title: Select a Beachhead Market
not_for: Generating segments from scratch or adding adjacent markets to the first product.
input_gate: Compare explicit candidates. A provisional choice may use assumptions, but record exclusions and reversal conditions.

selection.inclusions: One owner approves invoices and buys software
selection.homogeneity: Monthly time-based invoicing and owner approval

scorecard.rationale: A reachable local network; illustrative single criterion

example_note: Weights sum to one per candidate. Scores organize judgment; they are not proof of demand. Test whether plausible weight changes reverse the choice.
failure_case: Multiple chosen segments, inconsistent weights, or a weighted score that is not weight times score are rejected.
